title: Odd-degree coefficients of the odd part
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $S\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$ have odd cardinality. Define $f_{\\mathrm{odd}}(x)=(f(x)-f(-x))/2$. The Fourier coefficient of $f_{\\mathrm{odd}}$ at $S$, with respect to the uniform measure on the cube and the character $\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$, equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
